_what: R-C9-268 item 3: DEV-25c REGISTERED (not built, not painted). Pre-registered A/B adoption rule for the FIRST Phase 3' wavefront chunk.
what: INNER-128 PASTE + QUILTING. guided_paint stage pastes only the INNER 128 px of each 256-px overlap from the painted neighbour (the strip's far half); the chunk paints the OUTER 128 px itself. The stitch's DEV-26 cut is then confined to that outer half, where BOTH chunks hold their own new paint, so the hand-over runs between two fresh paints instead of ending on the redrawn strip (R-C9-247 mechanism 1, R-C9-249 finding: no cut inside today's overlap can reach the overlap-END line).
tier: Tier-B: guided_paint.py (stage: the paste rect; brief: the 'ALREADY PAINTED' strip text says 128 px) + guided_stitch.py (DEV-26 margin -> the band's outer half; the ramps unchanged as a partition of unity). Both BV2F-BEGIN/END blocks, ALLOWLIST, SHA256SUMS, verify.
flag: BV2F_DEV25C=1 (unset = today's full-256 paste and cut; with DEV23/25/26/27 also 0 = v1 byte for byte, proven by verify + a flag-off stitch cmp before use)
